purpose: Public storefront home read model returned by GET /api/v1/storefront/home.
businessRules: ProductCard carries product identity, SKU, slug, customer-facing description, customer-facing longDescription, family, type, pricing, ratings, badges, and media.
FeaturedCollection carries computed itemCount and optional productBadgeFilters so all curated collection counts use generic backend rules.
Media assets include versioned URLs, LQIP, dimensions, delivery mode, and optimized variants for responsive frontend rendering.
